statement: The proof body an Account signs is a function of its state and its terms: tokens ascending with their offdeltas, one transformer clause per open hold with one payment in (token, slot) order (the payer on the left moves the delta down), and a body the Account contract would refuse (more than MAX_HOLDS clauses, more than 128 tokens, response windows over a year, a value its types cannot carry) is refused before anyone signs it. Both replicas build the same bytes from the same state, so none of them comes from the wire.
source: first-moves.md A4; Account.sol _validateProofBody; coordinator relay 10-01 on A4
